title: Proposed lines arrive ticked, editable and traceable, in a window on a phone
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A completed inspection with several flagged findings, including two that would produce similar titles (seed two similar Not OK checkbox fields). A phone available. Choose a target so the proposed-lines panel opens.
custom_steps:
1. When the panel fills, confirm proposed lines arrive selected (default is to accept).
2. Confirm every proposed title, description, labor figure and part is editable in place before adding.
3. Confirm each proposed line names the finding it came from and carries that finding's identifier.
4. Confirm every flagged finding is represented by at least one line (a set too large to draft in one run is split, not dropped); on a phone confirm the panel opens as a full-screen modal.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Proposed lines arrive selected, so the default is to accept them.
  • Every proposed title, description, labor figure and part is editable in place before the lines are added.
  • Each proposed line names the finding it came from.
  • Every flagged finding is represented by at least one proposed line; if the set is too large to draft in one run, it is split across runs rather than the surplus being dropped.
  • Each proposed line carries the identifier of the finding it came from, so the traceability survives whatever the assistant returns.
  • On a phone the proposed-lines panel opens as a full-screen modal rather than a side panel.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9404 (S15 — Draft the lines with ShopCoach); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S15; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S15-R11: “Proposed lines will arrive selected, so the default is to accept them”
  • S15-R12: “Every proposed title, description, labor figure and part will be editable in place before the lines are added”
  • S15-R13: “Each proposed line will name the finding it came from”
  • S15-R14: “Every flagged finding will be represented by at least one proposed line however many findings there are. If the assistant cannot draft the whole set in one run, the set will be split across runs rather than the surplus being dropped”
  • S15-R21: “Each proposed line will carry the identifier of the finding it came from, so the traceability S15-R13 promises survives whatever the assistant returns”
  • S15-R26: “On a phone the proposed-lines panel opens as a full-screen modal rather than a side panel. Reading a drafted line and editing its title, description, labor and parts needs the width, and there is nowhere else on a phone for it to go”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
